title: Sentry egress orchestrator Terraform module for VPC security controls
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Build a composable Terraform module (sentry_egress_orchestrator) that codifies VPC security controls for Redwood Private deployments. The module will manage security groups, network ACLs (NACLs), Route53 private DNS entries, and tenant-level egress policy rules. It must support: 1) declarative per-tenant policy bundles (allow/deny lists by CIDR, ports, and FQDNs), 2) automatic policy versioning to enable safe upgrades and rollbacks, 3) an automated health-check surface for egress paths (active TCP/HTTP probes + synthetic DNS checks), and 4) drift detection hooks that trigger a remediation plan via Terraform Cloud runs or a reconciler Lambda when drift is detected.

This ticket scopes the initial module implementation and integration work needed for Private (VPC) rollout. Key constraints: must be cloud-agnostic between AWS accounts used by Private (initial AWS-focused implementation), follow Redwood security baselines (least privilege, audit logging), and expose predictable outputs consumed by the Console and Dedicated autoscaler components.
acceptance_criteria:
- Terraform module exists under modules/sentry_egress_orchestrator with clear README and example usage for single-tenant and multi-tenant VPCs.
- Module exposes inputs for: allowed_cidrs, allowed_ports, denied_fqdns, private_zone_map (zone_id -> records), tenancy_mode (per-tenant | shared), policy_version, and health_check_config.
- Module creates/updates: security groups with named rule sets, stateless/stated NACL entries with order index, Route53 private zone records for internal endpoints, and a Lambda/CloudWatch synthetic probe (or equivalent) when enabled.
- Upgrade path: bumping policy_version performs a canary application (configurable percentage of hosts) and supports rollback via terraform apply with previous version flag.
- Drift detection: a plan-only run is scheduled daily; the module publishes a `sentry_egress_last_plan` timestamp output and a boolean `sentry_egress_drift_detected` that can be read by the operator.
- Health checks: probes report to an observability metric (egress.sentry.probe_success_ratio) and an alert when failure rate > 5% for 10m.
- Security review completed and PR merged to infra-modules repo.
- Integration smoke validated in staging Private region (logs, metrics, and DNS resolution tests pass).

2025-01-15: Design doc drafted in Confluence; initial schema for per-tenant policy bundle reviewed with Security (minor feedback: require explicit deny list for 0.0.0.0/0 egress).
2025-01-22: Implemented SG and NACL submodules skeleton; added inputs for rule priorities and tenancy_mode. Local integration tests pass in dev account.

2025-02-02: Added Route53 private zone provisioning and record templating; DNS tests for internal endpoints pass in staging. Need IAM policy review for route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets permission scope.
2025-02-10: Drift detection PoC using terraform plan + state diff runs on Cloud CI; recording `sentry_egress_last_plan` as module output. Next: hook into remediation workflow and Console UI flagging.
